declare

begin
nullchk; check_package_failure;

select 'temp' into temp1 
from valid_master_codes 
where code = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type and
 code_type = 'GOALS'and

:ctrl_block_1.Custodian := null ;
:ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := null ;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'INGOL' then
 select inst_short_name,inst_id 
 into :ctrl_block_1.Custodian ,:ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian
 from institutions 
 where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.Custodian',navigable,PROPERTY_FALSE);

end if;

exception
 when no_data_found then

 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

declare
temp number :=0 ;
begin
if :system.trigger_item is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
end if ;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type is null then
 show_error('11247');
 check_package_failure;

end if; 


begin

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'SPGOL' then
 begin
 select sponsor_id into :g_custodian from sponsors 
 where upper(name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and rownum =1;

 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TRGOL' then

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TELRC' then

 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum =1;

 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');

 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'DNGOL' then

end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM1 (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GOAL_EXIST_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GOAL_EXIST_CHECK IS
TEMP NUMBER;
BEGIN
 

select nvl(sum(goal_count),0) into temp from goals where 
goal_start_date >= :ctrl_block_1.start_date and 
goal_end_date <= :ctrl_block_1.end_date and 
goal_type = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type
and goal_custodian = :ctrl_block_1.g_custodian;
 --message(to_char(temp));pause;
 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('11249');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 go_block('goals');
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;
